adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds pagination/state fields (`limit`, `offset`, `user_count`) to `Discourse.Group` and `findMembers()` mutates the same Group instance via `self.setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members: ... })` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js). Both `admin_group_route` and `group-members` route call `model.findMembers()` in `setupController`, where `model` is the shared group instance from `modelFor('group')`. That means pagination/members view-state is stored on (and mutates) the domain model instance and could be observed by any other holder of that instance. This is a concrete coupling/architecture concern grounded in the diff, though not a guaranteed functional break on its own.
